4935!1136.title: obu: parse AV2 OBU headers in dav2d_parse_sequence_header()
4935!1136.description:
It still parsed the AV1 OBU header (forbidden bit, 4-bit type, extension and
length field flags), so it never found the sequence header in AV2 streams and
returned ENOENT or EINVAL. Parse the length field, extension flag, 5-bit type
and layer ids like dav2d_parse_obus() does.

4935!1137.title: tests/seek_stress: don't leak input data and don't loop forever
4935!1137.description:
seek() and the decode loops read new data into the Dav2dData that still held
the previous packet (which wasn't consumed if dav2d_send_data() returned
EAGAIN, or wasn't sent at all while looking for a sequence header), leaking
it. Release the data before reading in seek(), and only read new data once
the current data has been consumed, like the dav2d tool does. Also release it
at the end, and initialize it, since its timestamp is used even if all seeks
fail.

The loop looking for a seekable position near the end retried the first
frame forever if seeking there failed; stop once it has been tried.

4935!1138.title: CI: also run the test data with 4 frame threads
4935!1138.description:
Adds a `--threads 4 --framedelay 4` run of the test data to test-debian, test-debian-asan and test-debian-tsan. Until now the test data only ran with up to 2 threads, apart from samples that set their own thread arguments. The same runs go into dav2d-test-data's own CI in dav2d-test-data!12.

Checked locally on main b130414d: all 38 samples in dav2d-test-data main + !6 + !9 + !10 pass with `--threads 4 --framedelay 4` in asm, C, ASan (C and asm) and TSan.

4935!1139.title: Avoid left shifts of negative strides
4935!1139.description:
With `--negstride`, cfl_ac, the MHCCP luma downsampling and ccso_prep_bo shift a negative stride left, which is undefined behaviour. UBSan aborts on 36 of the 38 samples in test-data main plus its then-pending MRs, for example:

```
src/ipred_tmpl.c:1065:24: runtime error: left shift of negative value -128
```

and at ipred_tmpl.c:900, :1189 and ccso_tmpl.c:95. CI didn't notice because `--negstride` only runs on asm builds (test-debian, TSan), so the second commit adds a `--negstride` pass to the UBSan job. With only that commit, test-debian-ubsan fails ([pipeline](https://code.videolan.org/EwoutH/dav2d/-/pipelines/753313)); with both it passes ([pipeline](https://code.videolan.org/EwoutH/dav2d/-/pipelines/753312)).

Tested locally with UBSan (C), 1 thread and 3 threads / frame delay 3, both with `--negstride`, on those 38 samples: all match their MD5s.

`--test-args=--negstride` needs the `=`: with a space, meson's argument parser takes `--negstride` as one of its own options.

5245!6.title: Add regression samples for round-3 conformance fixes
5245!6.description:
Seven small synthetic samples (about 32 KB in total), one for each decoder bug from the latest round of comparing dav2d with AVM on random encoder configurations. Each one fails on dav2d main 6fbce209 and passes with its fix, with and without asm (`--cpumask 0`). All seven fixes are merged now, and the whole testdata suite passes on main b130414d, with and without asm.

| sample | fix |
|---|---|
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l3.ref-frame-mvs0 | !1074 TMVP priority without ref_frame_mvs |
| avm.testsrc.256x256.l1.lossless-sb128 | !1077 lossless chroma with 128x128 SBs (frame threading only) |
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l3.cdef-on-skip-txfm0 | !1078 cdef_idx context |
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l1.tile-rows1 | !1079 LR units with tile rows |
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l8.sframe | !1083 primary_ref_frame on TIP output frames |
| avm.rot.128x128.l8.opfl-refine0 | !1084 refinemv on warped compound blocks |
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l2.fg11 | !1085 film grain mc_identity |

The lossless-sb128 bug only shows with frame threading, and the tests run with `--threads 1`, so the first commit lets a test entry carry extra decoder arguments; that sample uses `--threads 4 --framedelay 4`. The same could be used for the existing tilecols2 sample, whose crash was tile-threading only.

Sources are ffmpeg `testsrc2` and a synthetic rotating sine pattern; the encode commands are in the commit message, and all samples reproduce bit-exactly from them with avmenc av2-enc d891b232. MD5s are from av2-normative avmdec 14f43e4cd (av2-enc avmdec agrees).

The sample for !1073 (GDF on restricted switch frames), which is still open, moved to its own MR so this one can go in now.

5245!9.title: Add samples for formats and tools the suite didn't cover
5245!9.description:
Twelve small samples (19 KB in total) for formats and tools the suite didn't cover yet: 4:2:2, 4:4:4, 12-bit, still pictures, resizing, 256x256 superblocks, tile rows, and film grain at high bitdepth. So far it only had 4:2:0 at 8 and 10 bits.

How they were picked: edge coverage of a C-only dav2d build (`-fsanitize-coverage=trace-pc-guard`, main b130414d). From about 3800 random-config streams that decode correctly, a greedy pass took the smallest streams adding the most edges the existing samples don't reach. Together they raise the edges reached from 9434 to 11019 of 19423 (+17%).

| sample | covers |
|---|---|
| avm.testsrc.130x74.l2.422.12bit | 4:2:2 at 12 bits, two 64x64 chroma restoration units per 128x128 superblock |
| avm.mandel.200x112.l1.12bit.still-fg | still picture header, film grain at 12 bits |
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l1.422.opsets | 4:2:2 at 8 bits, operating point sets |
| avm.testsrc.130x74.l20.422.10bit.s1 | 4:2:2 at 10 bits, odd chroma width, 20 frames at speed 1 |
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l12.444.fg | 4:4:4, film grain, explicit reference map |
| avm.mandel.200x112.l6.resize9 | fixed resize (`--resize-mode=1`) |
| avm.testsrc.130x74.l4.10bit.sb256 | 256x256 superblocks |
| avm.testsrc.130x74.l12.10bit.tile-rows2 | tile rows |
| avm.testsrc.130x74.l20.10bit.resize9-fwdkf | resize with forward key frames |
| avm.mandel.200x112.l10.12bit.fg13 | film grain at 12 bits, inter frames |
| avm.mandel.200x112.l10.refs2-sef | two references, shown-existing frames |
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l1.12bit.still-screen | screen content still picture at 12 bits |

Each one matches avmdec on dav2d main b130414d with and without asm (`--cpumask 0`), with `--threads 4 --framedelay 4` (also under TSan), and with ASan+UBSan (C and asm). They also still match with !1073 and !1112 applied. The MD5s are from av2-normative avmdec 14f43e4cd built with `CONFIG_TESTONLY_12BIT_SUPPORT=1`, and av2-enc avmdec 800611294e agrees.

The 10/12-bit samples go in `avm-10bit`, which now also passes `--filmgrain=1` like `avm` does. The sources are plain ffmpeg lavfi (`testsrc2`, `mandelbrot`), and the commit message has every ffmpeg and avmenc command.

The first new commit builds the CI avmdec with `CONFIG_TESTONLY_12BIT_SUPPORT=1`: av2-normative leaves 12-bit decoding out by default and rejects those streams. This MR is on top of !6, so only the last two commits are new.

5245!10.title: Add regression samples for three recent decoder fixes
5245!10.description:
Regression samples for three decoder fixes from the last conformance round. Each one fails on dav2d main 28e39df9 and passes on b130414d, with and without asm (`--cpumask 0`).

| sample | size | fix |
|---|---|---|
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l4.444.mhccp | 6.4 KB | dav2d!1102 MHCCP edges on 4px chroma |
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l8.422.ii-smooth | 13 KB | dav2d!1117 interintra chroma edges above 32 px |
| avm.testsrc.176x144.l2.mfh-resize-kf | 4.7 KB | dav2d!1110 frame size from the multi-frame header |

The ii-smooth sample needs 8 frames; with 2-4 it doesn't hit the bug. I didn't find a sample from these sources that needs dav2d!1105 (inherited chroma txtp) on its own, so it has none.

The sources are ffmpeg `testsrc2`, and the commit message has the ffmpeg and avmenc commands (av2-enc 800611294e). The MD5s are from av2-normative avmdec 14f43e4cd, and av2-enc avmdec agrees. This MR is on top of !6, so only the last commit is new.

5245!12.title: CI: also test with 4 frame threads
5245!12.description:
Adds a `--threads 4 --framedelay 4` run of the samples to the jobs using the common script (plain, ASan, UBSan, aarch64, ppc64le) and to the TSan job, which only used 2 threads so far. The dav2d side is dav2d!1138.

Checked locally on dav2d main b130414d: all 38 samples in main + !6 + !9 + !10 pass with `--threads 4 --framedelay 4` in asm, C (`--cpumask 0`), ASan (C and asm) and TSan.

5245!13.title: Draft: Add IVF samples and seek_stress tests
5245!13.description:
dav2d's CI runs `meson test --suite testdata_seek-stress` twice in test-debian, but the suite has no tests ("No suitable tests defined"), and seek_stress only reads IVF while all samples here are raw OBU. This adds two small IVF samples (6.2 and 5.4 KB) with a key frame every 8 frames, registers them as decode tests and as seek_stress tests in `testdata_seek-stress`, and runs that suite in the common CI jobs. dav2d's MSan/UBSan/TSan jobs already build seek_stress, so their plain `meson test` runs pick the seek tests up too.

Draft until dav2d !1136 and !1137 are merged: before them seek_stress doesn't find a sequence header in AV2 streams and allocates without bound (on these samples it is killed at a 512 MB limit). Pipeline against a dav2d branch with both: https://code.videolan.org/EwoutH/dav2d-test-data/-/pipelines/753327 (green).

Locally, with both MRs (ASan): testdata 40/40 and testdata_seek-stress 2/2, also with `--threads 2 --framedelay 1`, `--threads 2 --framedelay 2` and `--threads 4 --framedelay 4`. Both samples match avmdec (av2-normative) and dav2d main with and without asm, with 4 frame threads and with `--negstride`.
